description: Search New Jersey's free public business registry by name, keywords, entity ID, principal, registered agent or previous name, check name availability, or list free document indexes. No login or proxy setup required.

businessNames.description: One or more names (mode=byName, availability). Name search is a prefix match: 'Amazon' finds names starting with Amazon, and a leading 'The' is ignored. Availability checks need a base name without a designator (no LLC, Inc., Corp., etc.) and at least 4 effective characters. Up to 50 names.
businessNames.title: Business names

cityFilter.description: Keep only businesses whose on-file city matches exactly (case-insensitive). Leave blank for all cities.
cityFilter.title: City filter

entityIds.description: Exact 10-digit New Jersey entity IDs (mode=byEntityId, documents). Invalid IDs are reported in the run status instead of being dropped silently. Up to 200 IDs.
entityIds.title: Entity IDs

entityTypes.description: Keep only these New Jersey entity types. Empty means no filter. Filters run on every page, not only after the 500-row display cap.
entityTypes.title: Entity types

keywordSearches.description: One or more keyword phrases (mode=byKeyword). Each phrase is split into words, and every word must appear in the business name; up to 5 words per phrase and 20 phrases.
keywordSearches.title: Keyword phrases

linkType.description: Which free Business Records Service search to use (mode=byLinkedName).
linkType.title: Reverse search type

linkedCity.description: Optional city filter for principal or registered-agent searches (mode=byLinkedName).
linkedCity.title: Linked city

linkedName.description: Last name, business name, registered-agent name, or previous/alternate name to search (mode=byLinkedName).
linkedName.title: Linked name

maxItems.description: Hard cap on emitted records (1-500, the source's display limit). Applied exactly, including when it is above 200.
maxItems.title: Max items

enumTitles: Reverse search by principal, registered agent or previous name
Check whether a business name is available
List the free document index for entity IDs
mode.title: Mode

title: New Jersey DOR Business Registry Input
